title: Web Surface Activation
brief: Concrete frontend activation for product pillar bundles in web/src/. Wire UI components, pages, and interactions so pillar capabilities are accessible through the web surface — not just API/MCP.

units.title: Activate speed/feed pillar in web/src/: UI for tier selection, parameter input, result display
Activate post-processing pillar in web/src/: G-code viewer, verification status, optimization controls
Activate print-to-program and ERP/quote pillars in web/src/
Integration test: verify all 4 pillar UIs connect to backend bundles end-to-end

exit_conditions: All 4 product pillars have functional web UI entry points
UI connects to backend activation bundles
Integration tests pass for each pillar
notes: Gap fix added during scrutiny — original roadmap lacked concrete frontend activation milestone
